source_differences: The 2011 US and 2022 Asian catalogues describe the same SKU but different source editions. A 135 mm head with 356 mm overall length is a selected cross-edition reconstruction hypothesis, not a verified production drawing.
The source masses refer to the hammer head, not the complete tool. Handle and attachment mass must be added explicitly.
The formerly indexed stanleytools.com 56-204 URL currently redirects to the homepage. The downloaded homepage is not recorded as a product source.
Other indexed head lengths and malformed web fields were not silently combined with the selected manufacturer catalogue row.
cad_and_dimensions: No official or licensed CAD retrieved. The original reconstruction infers head section from the nominal head mass and selected steel density. Head eye, handle profile, jacket thickness and retention construction are explicit local hypotheses, not factory dimensions or qualified joints.
